market_summary: US stocks had their worst day since April 2025 on Nov 5: Nasdaq -5.5%, S&P 500 -4.4%, Dow -3.4%. The chip index fell 12.3%, its worst day since 2020, on fears that midterm results bring tighter data center rules; Micron -17.5%, Marvell -16.4%, TSMC -10.8%, Nvidia -9.3%. A Fed official also argued for more hikes. After hours, Cloudflare rose about 15% on a beat and raise, Nvidia added 1.3% and Lumentum 3.1%.

AMZN.reason: Fell 2.2% in the AI rout, far less than chips. AWS thesis unchanged.

AXOS.reason: Down 2.2% with the market. No company news; cheap at about 9x forward.

BABA.reason: One of few gainers, up 2.6% as money left US AI names.

ENPH.reason: Down 8.2% on a risk-off day. Still waiting for a demand floor.

FIGR.reason: Down 9.2% with high-beta growth. No company news.

GOOGL.reason: Down 2.2%, held up well against the Nasdaq's 5.5% drop.

LDI.reason: Down 7.9%, then another 4% after hours. Q3 results due Nov 9.

META.reason: Down 4% with AI spenders on data center regulation fears.

MRVL.reason: Down 16.4%. Lumentum's strong guide supports optics demand, but policy risk on data centers is new. Stay on watch.

MU.reason: Down 17.5% on data center policy fears and a reported Taiwan plant pause. Now over 30% off its Oct 28 high. Forward P/E very low on peak-cycle earnings estimates.

NFLX.reason: Down 1.3%; not exposed to the AI capex trade.

NVDA.reason: Down 9.3%, near a seven-month low; up 1.3% after hours. About 15x forward.

RKT.reason: Down 1.3%, a mild move on a rough day.

TSM.reason: Down 10.8% with the chip index. Demand thesis unchanged; about 17x forward.

OPENAI.reason: Private. Data center regulation talk is a risk to its build-out plans.

headlines: Nasdaq closes -5.5% into correction; chip index -12.3%, worst day since 2020, on data-centre rule fears.
Holdings at the close: MU -17.5%, MRVL -16.4%, TSM -10.8%, NVDA -9.3%; BABA the only gainer.
Cloudflare beats: revenue +39%, Q4 guide above; up 14.7% after hours after -8.3% in the session.
Lumentum guides next quarter up about 27% but fell 18.7%; read-across for the Marvell deal.
Next: jobs Sat 00:30 AEDT; loanDepot Q3 Mon Nov 9; CPI Wed Nov 11; Nvidia Wed Nov 18.
